csv_project_name: Design Demolition Buildings Clarion and Edinboro Campuses
csv_scope_of_work: his Project is advertising for PROFESSIONAL SELECTIONS for design and/or engineering services. BRIEF DESCRIPTION: PennWest Clarion and Edinboro are two of three PASSHE campuses that comprise PennWest University. At PennWest Clarion and Edinboro there is excess square footage, relative to campus student body size. Much of this excess square footage is comprised of underutilized or obsolete buildings. The project is the demolition of buildings owned by the University at both campuses, which have not been renovated, have reached the end of their useful life, and have been vacated by the University for several years. PennWest Clarion: Four (4) separate campus buildings are included in this project, with a total building area to be demolished of 168,000+ SF. They are all located at the main PennWest Clarion campus. The buildings vary in age, size, and number of stories but are generally at least 50 years old, built of masonry and steel construction, and multiple stories. PennWest Edinboro: The campus building included in this project, the Lawrence Towers, is comprised of 3 distinct but connected sections. Built in 1976, the Lawrence Towers have been vacated and mothballed by the University. Each of the two (2) towers is 8 stories tall, with a single-story common area between. The total building area to be demolished is 186,000+ SF, and most of it is steel and masonry construction
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

short_description: Design and engineering services for demolition of obsolete university buildings on two campuses.
project_scope: Professional design and/or engineering services for demolition of university-owned buildings at two PennWest University campuses. services: Professional selections for design and/or engineering services related to demolition; requested disciplines include civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:

- Requested services include engineering disciplines, but the core task is demolition planning.
- University campus context is generally of interest, but here the scope is removal of obsolete buildings rather than new buildings or special structures.
- No indication of innovative structural systems, long spans, sustainability features, or architecturally demanding design.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice states only a total construction cost of 8.2 million USD and requests professional design and engineering services for demolition.
